component.name: Morph
component.summary: Convert images, audio and video locally
Конвертирует изображения, аудио и видео локально

description.p: Morph converts files on your own computer: drop them in, pick a format, and convert. Nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: Images: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, JPEG XL, GIF, TIFF, BMP; also reads SVG, PSD and camera RAW
Audio: MP3, FLAC, Ogg, Opus, WAV, M4A, AIFF, keeping tags and album art
Video: MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, AVI and GIF, or extract the soundtrack
Video encoding on the GPU with NVIDIA NVENC or VAAPI (Intel, AMD), falling back to the CPU

description.p: Morph is an independent program inspired by VERT. It runs vips and ffmpeg to do the conversions.
First release: images, audio and video, with NVENC and VAAPI video encoding.
